question: What happened to FHE at Shanghai noon on 2026-08-22, and which other coins moved similarly?
scope: All existing recent/tail Binance UM 5m series, same five-minute interval, noon 12:00–14:00 and same calendar day; FHE cached 1m and aggTrades
price_change_definition: Five-minute low/open - 1; later rebound uses the maximum of the next three five-minute closes, not a same-bar high of unknown order.
controls: Simultaneous cross-section and BTC/ETH distinguish broad market moves from a single-contract outlier; not a profitability hypothesis.
performance_metrics: AUC, trade PnL, fees and permutation significance do not apply: no fitted model, trading rule or profitable-edge claim.
